subject: English_grammar
text:
Note: These words are called modals. Modals are a special kind of auxiliary
verbs which have different functions. Look at the sentences below with
various meanings of ‘can’ and also the table showing different modals with
different functions.
a. Can|give you a cup of tea? (offer)
b. You can come to our party. (invitation)
c. Excuse me, can you please show me the way to the photocopy shop?
